question: Twelve boxes are placed along a circle. In each box, $1,2,3$ or $4$ balls are put such that the total number of balls in any $4$ consecutive boxes is the same. The number of ways this can be done is
solution: Once the number of balls in the first four boxes is chosen, the remaining choices become fixed. Each of the four boxes has four choices, giving $4^4$ cases in total.
